operators.name: White Wilderness Sled Dog Adventures
operators.summary: White Wilderness runs Alaskan husky trips from a remote kennel in the Superior National Forest outside Ely, from a short guided ride up to multi-day lodge and yurt trips. On the longer trips guests harness and drive; the introductory ride keeps the guide in the main driving position.
operators.season: Thursday–Monday, mid-December until the snow melts in late March; yurt trips are listed mid-December to mid-March.
operators.duration: Introductory ride 60–90 minutes (about 20–30 minutes on the sled); half-day about 3 hours; 3/4-day about 4 hours; tandem day about 9 a.m.–3 p.m.; multi-day lodge and yurt trips of 1.5 to 4 nights.
operators.priceNote: Per person. Introductory ride $230 (page headed New for 2026-27; 15% off ages 12 and under). Other published per-person prices are not labeled with a season year: half-day $295 weekday / $325 weekend-holiday; 3/4-day $340 / $390; tandem day $360 / $425; premier solo day $460 / $570; yurt escape $960 (premier yurt escape $1,395); classic tandem yurt $1,920; premier solo yurt $2,470; classic lodge $2,040 full trip or $1,200 with your own lodging and off-trail meals; Whispering Pines premium lodge $2,995 or $2,400 with your own lodging and off-trail meals. Child and group discounts are percentages, not separate dollar fares.
operators.kidNote: Introductory ride, half-day, 3/4-day, and tandem day list a minimum age of 6 and call the trips good for families. Yurt escape, classic yurt, and classic lodge list minimum age 8. Premier day, premier yurt, and Whispering Pines list minimum age 14.

operators.name: Wintergreen Dogsled Lodge
operators.summary: Wintergreen Dogsled Lodge, on White Iron Lake east of Ely, is booking 2026-27 lodge vacations where beginners mush their own teams. Day trips and multi-night lodge, camping, photo, and yoga packages run from December into March, with guides on skis alongside the sleds.
operators.season: Day trips Dec 15–Mar 23; lodge trips listed for the 2026-27 season, December–March, including dated January–February 2027 specials.
operators.duration: Half-day about 3 hours; full day about 9 a.m.–4 p.m.; lodge packages of 3, 4, or 5 nights.
operators.priceNote: Day-trip rates are per person with two guests per sled: half-day kids 5–11 $150, youth 12–17 $200, adults $250; full day $250 / $325 / $400. A one-person solo sled is described as 50% more, without a separate dollar figure. About page lists 4-night trips at $1,175–$1,875 per person. Dated 2027 add-ons: photo workshop $2,275 per adult (Jan 24–29, 2027); yoga trip $2,075 per adult (Feb 24–28, 2027). Parent/child pairs are $2,475 per pair, not per person. A Jan 31–Feb 5, 2027 CME retreat is listed at $3,000 all-inclusive without saying per person, so it is not in priceMax. An older schedule PDF with 2022-23 rates was not used.
operators.priceQuote: Half day rates: Adults $250, Youth(12-17) $200, Kids(5-11) $150 Full day (includes lunch): Adult $400, Youth $325, Kids $250
operators.kidNote: The about page says kids are welcome. Day trips price ages 5–11 and say people ages 5–85 have done them. One 4-night lodge description says kids ages 6 and up. Parent/child trips are for a child ages 7–12. People over 250 pounds may find balancing on the sleds difficult; that is not stated as a hard limit.

operators.name: Boundary Country Trekking
operators.summary: Boundary Country Trekking offers Gunflint Trail mushing around Poplar Lake, with guests taking turns driving a team of five or six huskies while a guide travels on a separate sled. The published trips pair the run with nights at Poplar Creek Guesthouse or a night at the Croft Yurt.
operators.season: December through mid-March, depending on snow. Day-trip packages begin in early December; two- to three-day yurt trips begin the third week of January and end mid-March. The page does not name 2025-26 or 2026-27.
operators.duration: Half-day or full-day mushing with a two-night B&B stay, or two full days of mushing with two nights.
operators.priceNote: Rates are for two persons and include lodging, not a sled-only per-person fare. Taxes and gratuities are extra.
operators.priceQuote: Full day of mushing / two nights at Poplar Creek B&B: $1132 / 2 persons. 1/2 day of mushing / two nights at Poplar Creek B&B: $924 / 2 persons. 2 full days mushing / 2 nights: $2100 / 2 persons.

operators.name: Gunflint Lodge
operators.summary: Gunflint Lodge on Gunflint Lake offers a four-night midweek dog-mushing package with three sled rides, meals, and other winter activities. The page also says dog-sled rides can be reserved on their own all winter, with two guests riding together unless a weight limit is exceeded.
operators.season: Package listed as a midweek special, Sundays–Fridays, dates marked TBD and not valid MLK or Presidents weekends. Separate rides described as available all winter. Page footer copyright 2026.
operators.duration: Four nights with one sled ride per day for three days; ride length depends on availability.
operators.priceNote: Package pricing is shown as a dollar sign for two people in a cabin, but the dollar amounts did not render on the page. No per-person sled fare is published there.
operators.kidNote: Guests ride two at a time unless a weight limit is exceeded. No weight number or age rule is printed.

sources.what: Live dog-mushing package and a-la-carte winter rides; prices did not render

operators.name: Chilly Dogs Sled Dog Trips
operators.summary: Chilly Dogs runs appointment-only trips from an outpost on Esterberg Road near Ely, with a dog-yard visit, sled orientation, and time either riding or driving. Winter 2026/2027 half-days are an 8-mile Snowy Owl run and a longer 15-mile Backcountry Trek, and fall visits are dog-powered training rides.
operators.season: Winter sled trips generally mid-December through late March. Autumn mushing from October until there is enough snow for sleds.
operators.duration: Snowy Owl about 3+ hours with roughly an hour on the trail; Backcountry Trek about 4 hours with about 2 hours on the trail; autumn visit about 1.5–2 hours.
operators.priceNote: 2026/2027 winter rates are per person. Snowy Owl: age 15+ $240 weekday / $260 weekend-holiday; ages 6–14 $170 / $190; age 5 and under $70 / $80. Backcountry Trek: age 15+ $280 / $310; ages 6–14 $210 / $230; age 5 and under $90 / $100. Autumn training ride: $120 age 15+, $95 ages 6–14, $50 age 5 and under. Weekend/holiday means Saturdays, Sundays, Dec 26–Jan 1, and MLK and Presidents Day Mondays.
operators.kidNote: Snowy Owl is described as suitable for all ages, with fares for age 5 and under. Personal weight is about 275 lb on Snowy Owl and about 245 lb on Backcountry Trek.

operators.name: Kiwatchi Adventures
operators.summary: Kiwatchi Adventures, on Highway 1 in Isabella, offers winter sled-dog rides that run until the snow is gone and cart rides in spring and fall when it is under 60°F. The kennel also guides ice-fishing days reached by dog team and says the outings are for families as well as adults.
operators.season: Winter sled rides until the snow disappears; cart rides in spring and fall below 60°F.
operators.duration: FAQ says guided dog-sled tours typically last 3–4 hours. Another page says most rides last 1–3 hours depending on the package.
operators.priceNote: No dollar prices are published on the pages reviewed.
operators.kidNote: FAQ answers “Are your adventures family-friendly?” and “Are sled dog rides suitable for children?” with yes, and asks guests with young children to call before booking.

operators.name: Positive Energy Outdoors
operators.summary: Positive Energy Outdoors leads dog-sled tours from a kennel on Datka Road in Duluth, including short Bog and Island Lake trips, a family tour, and a kennel visit paired with draft horses. A musher rides each sled for instruction, and one group option says guests learn to drive.
operators.duration: Bog and Island Lake tours listed as 2 hours; a full-day dog-sled and draft-horse option is also listed.
operators.priceNote: The dog-sledding page prints $225 (Bog, 2 hours), $275 (Island Lake), $400 (full-day dog sledding and draft horses), $495 (family tour), and $595 (group dog sledding with optional horse-drawn sleigh or wagon). It never says these amounts are per person, per sled, or per group.
operators.priceQuote: $225 Dog Sledding – Bog Tour. $275 Dog Sledding – Island Lake Tour. $495 Dog Sledding – Family Tour.
operators.kidNote: Family tour says the dogs love meeting children. Children under 60 pounds can ride with an adult on toboggan sleds, and children under 100 pounds can ride with an adult on double-driver sleds.

sources.what: Live Duluth tour menu, printed prices, and child seating rules

operators.name: Endurance Kennels
operators.summary: Endurance Kennels runs private sprint-husky rides in the forest between Duluth and Two Harbors, with a kennel visit included and a musher driving most sleds. A tandem ride lets adults take turns driving, and the booking page’s trail note dated December 9, 2025 said the 2025-2026 season was open.
operators.season: Sled rides listed seven days a week in season, with extra afternoon slots after February 1. Fall training rides early October through mid-December or until there is enough snow. Latest on-page trail note is December 9, 2025 for the 2025-2026 season.
operators.duration: Quick Trip about 1 hour total for groups of 2–4 (about 20 minutes on the sled); Lead Dog about 90 minutes (about 30 minutes on the sled); tandem about 1 hour (about 30 minutes on the sled); fall training about 1 hour (about 25 minutes and 4.5 miles).
operators.priceNote: Rides-index prices are per person. Quick Trip: adults $175, teens 13–17 $140, age 12 $125, ages 6–11 $90, age 5 and under $50. Lead Dog: $210 for adults and children over 13, $125 for children 12 and under. Tandem: $250 adults only, two-person minimum. Fall training ride in a side-by-side: adults $75, children 12 and under $40. The Quick Trip product page matches the $175 adult fare.
operators.priceQuote: Price (per person): $ 175 adult(s), $ 140 for teens (13-17 y/o) $ 125 for child(ren) 12 y/o, $ 90 for child(ren) 11-6 y/o, $ 50 for child(ren) 5 and under
operators.kidNote: Pages say family fun for all ages and price children, including age 5 and under. Tandem driving is adults only. FAQ says a musher drives standard rides; guests may be invited onto the runners, and the tandem product is the drive-your-own option.

operators.name: Wilderness Inquiry
operators.summary: Wilderness Inquiry still lists dogsledding on its Boundary Waters Lodge-Based Winter Adventure at Camp Menogyn near Grand Marais, mixed with skiing and snowshoeing. The dogsled portion is described as at least a 15-minute ride when snow and the dogs allow, plus a chance to help feed or harness.
operators.season: Winter lodge trip. The page does not list specific 2026-27 departure dates and says private dates can be arranged. A page image path is dated January 2026.
operators.duration: 4-day lodge trip. Dogsledding is at least a 15-minute ride, longer if conditions allow. Daily activity on the wider trip is about 2–6 hours.
operators.priceNote: $1,285 is the adult price for the full 4-day lodge trip, not a sled-only fare. Dogsledding is one activity among skiing, snowshoeing, and sauna time. Single rooms cost extra; no dollar amount is shown.
operators.kidNote: Group type is Adult Trips. Participants should be able to walk at least one mile on uneven snowy ground.

operators.priceNote: No price or trip length is published on the pages that loaded. The site says on-trail mushing time stays the same while total time can vary with group size.

operators.name: Nature's Kennel Sled Dog Adventures
operators.summary: Nature’s Kennel in McMillan is booking half-day, 10-mile trips for the 2026-27 winter, seven days a week from early December through early April once snow allows. Guests can drive their own team, ride with a guide, or switch halfway when two people share a sled.
operators.season: 2026-27 season: early December (snowfall dependent) through early April. Trips at 9 a.m. and 1 p.m., seven days a week.
operators.duration: Half day, about 9 a.m.–noon or 1–4 p.m., covering 10 miles.
operators.priceNote: 2026-2027 page, per person where stated: drive your own sled $300 weekday / $320 weekend-holiday; children ages 4–10 $95; ages 3 and under free. Shared-sled prices are for two people, not per person: one driver and one rider $550 weekday / $590 weekend; two riders $500 / $540, and each of those two riders must weigh under 210 lb. Holiday rates also apply Dec 20, 2026–Jan 3, 2027. A separate day-trips page lists different drive-your-own figures ($280 weekday / $305 weekend) without a season year; those were not used for priceMin/priceMax.
operators.priceQuote: 2026-2027 Pricing/Information: Drive your Own Sled $300 per person ... Weekend/Holiday Trips ... Drive your Own Sled $320 per person
operators.kidNote: Half-day trips are described as suitable for all ages, and riding is called a good option for small children. Children must be 10 to drive. Ages 3 and under ride free; ages 4–10 are $95.

operators.name: Husky Haven Kennels
operators.summary: Husky Haven in Shingleton books private winter tours of about 8–10 miles on a double-driver sled, so guests drive while someone coaches them. The same site offers summer kennel tours and, below 50°F, a short ride with the dogs.
operators.season: Winter sled tours and summer kennel tours; cool-weather rides when the temperature is below 50°F. No calendar year is printed.
operators.duration: Winter tours about 3–4 hours, including an 8–10 mile run. Summer kennel tour length is not stated.
operators.priceNote: All of these are per person. Winter tour $200. Summer ride below 50°F $75, including the kennel tour. Kennel tour alone $25.
operators.priceQuote: Pricing for our winter tours are $200/person and there is no age limit.
operators.kidNote: Winter tours say there is no age limit and that young and old can join. Tours are private to the booking group.

operators.name: Otter River Sled Dog
operators.summary: Otter River Sled Dog in Chassell books kennel and dryland visits year-round and, in snow, a ride with a guide or coaching to drive your own team. The basic visit ends with a 3-mile run, with a 10-mile option, and fall color tours put a dog team in front of a side-by-side.
operators.season: Year-round kennel and dryland tours; sled rides when there is snow; fall color tours.
operators.duration: Basic kennel tour 2 hours, with a standard 3-mile run or an optional 10-mile run. Per-hour group tours are listed as 1 hour.
operators.priceNote: Basic kennel tour is listed at $100 for 2 hours, and per-hour group tours from $250, without saying per person. Dryland adventures from $50 and UTV tours from $100 are separate from sled rides. Discounts exist for seniors 65+, children under 10, and veterans, with no dollar amounts.
operators.priceQuote: Basic Kennel Tour 2 hr 100 US dollars. Per-Hour Group Tours 1 hr From 250 US dollars.
operators.kidNote: The kennel-tour page says you can take children for a supervised ride, and the booking page offers a discount for children under 10.

operators.duration: Winter visit about 3 hours, with about 45–60 minutes on the trail. Summer tour slots are 1.5 hours.
operators.priceNote: Those lines are summer kennel admission, per person, not the winter sled ride. Groups of 8 or more are $13 each. No winter sled price is published, so priceMin and priceMax are left null.
